source.preview_owner: actual same-kernel CheckoutPreviews using captured concrete private-branded methods
source.grant: descriptor-checked, detached and frozen original GrantRef validated by unchanged C1; no current provider grant authority
source.provenance: process-local WeakMap ties source instance, original opaque Scope and exact native preview object; JSON copies cannot rehydrate it
source.held_erasure: after callback-capable native currentness and closure checks, an inert exact tenant/store/original-subject erasure_held event read denies new binding publication and currentness; plain holds permit construction, while release or expiry cannot revoke a prior erasure request
source.cache: no new strong preview cache; existing CheckoutPreviews limits and expiry apply

claim.constructor: existing kernel and correlation, plus optional concrete starts owner
claim.transaction: reject pre-existing transactions before database work; construct and retain inside the existing top-level transaction; return only after COMMIT
claim.exact_repetition: retained original view after all current native checks; changed complete original conflicts

storage.retention: unchanged C2 v1 original canonical START in its existing personal projection; existing privacy, hold, erase, uninstall, restore and import owners
storage.journal_validation_limit: 10000 rows per validation scan; normal calls are tenant/store scoped and global restore fails closed at the same bound
storage.after_expiry_close_restart: caller-held data and journal rows are historical; native use requires an actual current owner preview and cannot be reconstructed from history

claim_errors: existing finite COMMAND_CLAIM codes; source failures map to COMMAND_CLAIM_BINDING_INVALID
excluded: durable native binding or duplicate execution lifecycle
raw proof, receipt, secret or credential retention
business permission, budget, reservation or execution
